items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think I actually saw the footage of this and that’s what turned me out, I had to go buy the album when I saw this on TV, I think I saw this on PBS and I said, “Oohh-wee.” ... this album changed my life when I heard this when we get to Enlightenment, that’s the Quartet, Azar Lawrence, Jiunie Booth,

ctx.x: Wayne was in the band? Oh, so while he was with Miles he played with Blakey?
He did some tours with him, I know Jiunie was there.
What was the name of the saxophone player? I’m trying to think of his name.
